name: Crawling and indexing are different controls
gscNote: Page indexing shows Indexed, though blocked by robots.txt, which is Google telling you exactly this and is routinely read as a warning rather than as the answer.
manualCheck: For every URL you want out of the index, confirm the crawler can still fetch it. Use the URL Inspection tool: it must report the page as crawlable and show the noindex it found. If it reports the page as blocked, the noindex is not doing anything.
